configurePresets.name: host-dev
configurePresets.description: Builds and runs on the dev machine with MockBackend standing in for real GPIO. This is what you iterate against and run tests with.

configurePresets.name: pi0-release
configurePresets.displayName: Raspberry Pi Zero (armv6) cross release build
configurePresets.description: Cross-compiles for the Pi Zero 1.1 (ARM1176JZF-S, armv6). Requires an armv6-CAPABLE arm-linux-gnueabihf toolchain -- see docs/CROSS_COMPILE.md; a plain 'apt install gcc-arm-linux-gnueabihf' (Debian/Ubuntu) is confirmed NOT to qualify, and the configure step will refuse to proceed with one. libgpiod is cross-built from source automatically (ICOM_LIBGPIOD_BUILD_FROM_SOURCE, on by default) -- no prebuilt armv6 libgpiod needed for it. libsystemd has no such source-build option, though -- pass -DICOM_PI_SYSROOT=/path/to/a/raspberry-pi-os-sysroot (with libsystemd-dev installed there) or the configure step fails looking for it.

configurePresets.name: pi0-debug
configurePresets.displayName: Raspberry Pi Zero (armv6) cross debug build
configurePresets.description: Same target as pi0-release but unoptimized (-O0 -g), for gdbserver debugging on real hardware -- see docs/VSCODE_WSL2_SETUP.md. Optimized RelWithDebInfo code is usable with a debugger but variables/steps can appear to jump around; use this preset when that gets in the way.
